decision.reason: [ev-833d940f9c35] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that a metrics.go log line was added for requests from the querier to the ingester, and it links to PR 11571 for the details. It names the subject and an additive change, but it does not say which environments are exposed. It gives no log level, no config flag or default-on status, and no deployment modes or components that emit the line. Without the PR, the open applicability aspect can't be written from the evidence without guessing.
